children: {b:1.S Sub-Contract Terms and Conditions}

children.name: text
children: {b:1. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION}

children.name: text
children: 1.1.   In these terms and conditions the following definitions apply:

children.name: text
children: {b:“Bank Holiday“}: means Christmas Day, Boxing Day, Good Friday, Easter Monday, New Year’s Day, or any other day which under the Banking

children.name: text
children: and Financial Dealings Act 1971 is a bank holiday in England;

children.name: text
children: {b:“CDM Regulations”}: the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 2015.

children.name: text
children: {b:“Commencement Date”}: is the date for commencement of the Sub-Contract Works as set out within the Order or such other date agreed in writing between the Parties.

children.name: text
children: {b:“Contractor”}: the person(s), firm or company identified in the Order.

children.name: text
children: {b:“Defects Liability Period”}: the defects liability period set out in the Order.

children.name: text
children: {b:“Due Date”}: has the meaning given in clause 4.3.1.

children.name: text
children: {b:“First Retention Release Date”}: has the meaning set out in the Order.

children.name: text
children: {b:“Gross Application for Payment”}: has the meaning given in clause 4.3.3.

children.name: text
children: {b:“Intellectual Property Rights”}: means patents copyrights, moral rights, related rights, patents, trademarks, service marks, design rights, database rights, semiconductor topography rights, any undisclosed or confidential information such as know how, trade secrets or inventions (whether patentable or not) and any other rights of a similar nature wherever in the world recognised and whether registered or capable of registration or not and including applications for any of the same, relating to designs, drawings, models, plans, specifications, design details, photographs, brochures, reports, notes of meetings, CAD materials and any other materials or documents which have been or are written, originated or made by or on behalf of the Sub-Contractor in connection with the Site or in the course of performing the Sub-Contract Works (whether in existence or to be made).

children.name: text
children: {b:“Interim Valuation Date”}: the interim valuation date as set out in the Order.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Main Contract"}: the contract entered into by the Contractor and its client to carry out the Main Contract Works of which the Sub-Contract Works form a part, as more particularly described in the Order.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Main Contract Works"}: the works to be carried out by the Contractor under the Main Contract, as more particularly described in the Order.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Contractors Nominated Contact"}: person specified in the Sub-Contract or any replacement notified to the Sub-Contractor. Any change to the Contractor’s Nominated Contact shall be communicated to the Sub-Contractor by notice in accordance with clause 13.1

children.name: text
children: {b:"Numbered Documents"}: the documents listed under Sub-Contract Agreement, section 4. Sub-Contract Documents to the Order, which are available at the Contractor's head office for inspection by the Sub-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: {b:“Order”}: the order given by the Contractor to the Sub-Contractor to carry out the Sub-Contract Works together with any documents contained or referred to in the Order.

children.name: text
children: {b:“Parties”}: means the Parties to the Sub-Contact, namely the Contractor and the Sub-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: {b:“Payment Notice”}: has the meaning given in clause 4.3.5.

children.name: text
children: {b:“Period for Completion”}: either the number of weeks as stated in the Order within which the Sub-Contract Works are to be carried out and completed or the fixed date by which the Sub-Contract Works are to be carried out and completed (subject to any adjustments confirmed or notified by the Contractor in Writing) as identified in the Order as the period for completion of the Sub-Contract Works including any sectional completion dates specified in the Order.

children.name: text
children: {b:“Retention Percentage”}: is the retention percentage set out within the Order or such other amount agreed in writing between the Parties.

children.name: text
children: {b:“Second Retention Release Date”}: has the meaning set out in the Order.

children.name: text
children: {b:“Site”}: the site of the Sub-Contract Works described in the Order.

children.name: text
children: {b:“Sub-Contract”}: the sub-contract between the Contractor and the Sub-Contractor consisting of the Order, these terms and conditions and all the other Sub-Contract Documents.

children.name: text
children: {b:“Sub-Contractor”}: the person(s), firm or company identified in the Order.

children.name: text
children: {b:“Sub-Contract Documents”}: these terms and conditions, the Numbered Documents and any details, drawings, specifications or other documents relating to the Sub-Contract Works and identified or referred to in the Order (including any additions or variations thereto and either confirmed or notified to the Sub-Contractor by the Contractor in Writing).

children.name: text
children: {b:“Sub-Contract Sum”}: the sum stated in the Order for carrying out the Sub-Contract Works which is based on the Rates referred to or contained within the Sub-Contract (if any).

children.name: text
children: {b:“Sub-Contract Works”}: the sub-contract works identified in the Order including (where appropriate) design services, the supply of labour and installation to be carried out in accordance with the Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: {b:“Writing”}: includes letter, e-mail, cable and facsimile transmission and comparable means of communication.

children.name: text
children: {b:Interpretation}

children.name: text
children: These terms and conditions shall be deemed to be incorporated in any contract, agreement or Order between the Contractor and the Sub-Contractor and shall be in substitution for any other terms and conditions introduced before or after the date of the Order (unless expressly identified and agreed to in Writing by the Contractor). Furthermore, any action undertaken by the Sub-Contractor in pursuit of their obligations under the Sub-Contract will be deemed an explicit agreement to the terms of the Sub-Contract and cannot be rescinded, altered or amended in any way without mutual agreement by the Parties.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provision of the Sub-Contract, no sums shall become due to the Sub-Contractor until it has executed and returned the Order to the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Any materials and goods or other things shall remain at the risk of the Sub-Contractor who shall be responsible for any loss or damage of such items until completion of the Sub-Contract Works. The Sub-Contractor shall ensure that such items are properly protected against any loss or damage and adequately covered for their full reinstatement value by a suitable policy of insurance.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor gives no guarantee of continuity of work or that the Sub-Contractor will be afforded the opportunity to carry out and complete the Sub-Contract Works in a continuous manner. The Contractor may at its discretion amend the timing or programme of the Sub-Contract Works to suit its requirements without adjustment to the Sub-Contract Sum or incurring any liability to the Sub-Contractor for additional costs, losses or expenses.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall be deemed to have full knowledge of the provisions of the Main Contract, a copy of which is available for inspection at the Contractor's premises by the Sub-Contractor, and the Contractor shall, if so requested in writing by the Sub-Contractor, make available for inspection a copy of the Main Contract, with the exception the Contractor's rates and prices included therein.

children.name: text
children: Insofar as the Contractor's obligations under the Main Contract relate and apply to the Sub-Contract Works or any part of them and notwithstanding any other provision of this Sub-Contract, the Sub-Contractor shall observe, perform and comply with those obligations and shall indemnify and hold harmless the Contractor against and from:

children.name: text
children: Any breach, non-observance or non-performance by the Sub-Contractor or his employees or agents of any of the provisions of the Main Contract;

children.name: text
children: Any act or omission of the Sub-Contractor or his employees or agents which involves the Contractor in any liability to its client under the provisions of the Main Contract;

children.name: text
children: Any delay or failure by the Sub-Contractor or his employees or agents to perform within the timescales stipulated within the Main Contract; and

children.name: text
children: Any failure by the Sub-Contractor or his employees or agents to provide information in a format as required by the Main Contract.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall indemnify the Contractor against all costs, losses, expenses, damages, claims and demands incurred by the Contractor as a result of any breach by the Sub-Contractor or any of its servants or agents of any of these terms and conditions or any act, negligence, omission, default breach of statutory duty or otherwise on the part of the Sub-Contractor or any of its servants or agents.

children.name: text
children: References within these terms and conditions to "completion" are, unless the context requires otherwise, to practical completion determined in accordance with the relevant contract.

children.name: text
children: These terms and conditions shall be read and interpreted so as to incorporate any "Special Conditions" set out in the Order.

children.name: text
children: {b:2. COMMENCEMENT AND COMPLETION}

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall commence the Sub-Contract Works either:

children.name: text
children: On the date specified in the Order; or

children.name: text
children: On the expiry of the period of notice to commence the Sub-Contract Works identified in the Order; or

children.name: text
children: Upon such alternative date as may be required by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall carry out and complete the Sub-Contract Works to the satisfaction of the Contractor and:

children.name: text
children: Expeditiously, diligently and in a proper and workmanlike manner in compliance with the Sub-Contract;

children.name: text
children: In accordance with all relevant legislation, regulations, British Standards and Codes of Practice, consents and approvals;

children.name: text
children: In accordance with any programme notified in writing by the Contractor to the Sub-Contractor or referred to or contained within the Sub-Contract or Main Contract or any amended or revised programme which the Contractor may from time to time notify in Writing to the Sub-Contractor;

children.name: text
children: shall strictly comply with the Working Rule Agreement as currently laid down by the National Joint Council for the Building Industry;and

children.name: text
children: shall strictly comply with the requirements of the Contractor’s Health and Safety policies and requirements.

children.name: text
children: Without prejudice to clause 2.3, so that all workmanship, materials and goods shall be of the kinds and standards described or referred to in the Sub-Contract or to the extent that no such standards are described shall be of a reasonable standard having regard to the nature of the Main Contract Works and the Sub-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: Where and to the extent that the Sub-Contract Works require the Sub-Contractor to undertake any design or the selection or specification of any materials or goods:

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall be fully responsible in all respects for the design of such part or parts of the Sub-Contract Works including any design prepared by or on behalf of the Contractor and referred to or contained within the Sub-Contract;

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall exercise all reasonable skill, care and diligence in the design of such part or parts of the Sub-Contract Works as is to be expected of a properly qualified and competent design sub-contractor experienced in carrying out work such as its duties under the Sub-Contract in relation to developments of similar scope, size, nature, timescale and complexity and on a similar site or at a similar location to the Site;

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contract Works will comply with any performance specification or requirement referred to or contained within the Sub-Contract; and

children.name: text
children: So far as procurable all materials and goods shall be of the kinds described within the Order and shall be fit for their intended purpose.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall indemnify the Contractor against any expenditure or other financial loss to the extent that it is incurred as a result of any breach of his obligations contained in clause 2.3.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor further warrants it has not used or specified for use and shall not use or specify for use in connection with the Sub-Contract Works any goods, materials, substances or products not in accordance with relevant British and European Standards and Codes of Practice or otherwise generally known or suspected within the construction or engineering industries at the time of use or specification (as appropriate) to be deleterious to health and safety or to the durability of the Sub-Contract Works in the particular circumstances in which they are used.

children.name: text
children: If at any time it becomes reasonably apparent to the Sub-Contractor that the progress of the Sub-Contract Works is being delayed and/or the Sub-Contract Works will not be completed within the Period for Completion and/or the Sub-Contractor has incurred or reasonably expects to incur additional costs / direct loss and expense, the Sub-Contractor shall immediately inform the Contractor in Writing notifying the anticipated duration of any delay, if applicable, and/or any additional costs / direct loss and expense that the Sub-Contractor has incurred or reasonably expects to incur as a result of the matter and the steps it is taking to mitigate the delay. It shall be a condition precedent to the grant of an extension of time that the Sub-Contractor must give notice of a claim to the Contractor within 7 days of becoming aware (or within 7 days from when a prudent and experienced Sub-Contractor should have become aware) that the progress of the Sub-Contract Works is being or is likely to be delayed. If the Sub-Contractor fails to give notice of a claim within such period of 7 days, the Period for Completion shall not be extended, the Sub-Contractor shall not be entitled to any additional payment and the Contractor shall be discharged from all and any liabilities in connection with such claim.

children.name: text
children: If following the receipt of such notice as referred to in clause 2.7, the Contractor is of the opinion that the cause of the matter referred to in the notice is due to:

children.name: text
children: Any circumstances or occurrence (other than a breach of the Sub-Contract by the Sub-Contractor) entitling the Contractor to an extension of time for completion of the Main Contract Works and/or additional costs / direct loss and expense under the Main Contract; or

children.name: text
children: The ordering of any variation of the Sub-Contract Works to which clause 2.8.1 does not apply; or

children.name: text
children: Any breach of the Sub-Contract by the Contractor,

children.name: text
children: Then in any such event the Sub-Contractor shall be entitled to such extension to the Period for Completion and to such proportion of its additional costs / direct loss and expense as may in all the circumstances be fair and reasonable, provided that it shall be a condition precedent to the Sub-Contractor's entitlement to any such extension of time and/or additional cost / direct loss and expense that the Sub-Contractor has provided notice in accordance with clause 2.7, and in no circumstances shall the relief to which the Sub-Contractor is entitled pursuant to this clause exceed the relief to which the Contractor is properly entitled under the Main Contract for the equivalent matter(s) hereunder.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall notify the Contractors Nominated Contact in Writing of the date when in his opinion the Sub-Contract Works are practically complete and he has complied sufficiently with clauses 3.15 and any relevant requirements of the Main Contract in respect of that completed work.

children.name: text
children: Upon receipt of the notice served by the Sub-Contractor in accordance with clause 2.9, as soon as the Contractor is satisfied that such work is complete and that there has been such compliance, the Contractor shall as soon as reasonably practicable notify the Sub-Contractor and completion of such work shall be deemed for all the purposes of the Sub-Contract to have taken place on the date notified by the Contractor or on such other date as is either agreed or determined in accordance with the dispute resolution procedures of the Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: If the Sub-Contractor fails to complete the Sub-Contract Works or such works in any section within the Period for Completion the Sub-Contractor shall pay to the Contractor or allow the Contractor to deduct from sums otherwise due the amount of any direct loss and/or expense suffered or incurred by the Contractor and caused by that failure including but not limited to any damages payable by the Contractor to the Employer under the Main Contract in consequence thereof.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall ensure that any off-site works are carried out in accordance with any details set out in the Order.

children.name: text
children: {b:Liability for Defects}

children.name: text
children: Any material defects, shrinkages or other material defaults in the Sub-Contract Works which appear within the Defects Liability Period and which are due to design, materials or workmanship not in accordance with the Sub-Contract shall be made good by the Sub-Contractor at its own cost and to the satisfaction of the Contractor within 7 days (24 hours in the case of an emergency) after notification from the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall indemnify and hold harmless the Contractor against all costs, losses, expenses, damages, claims and demands incurred by the Contractor as a result of any defects in the Sub-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:Site Conditions}

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor confirms that he has investigated and shall be deemed to have made all reasonable allowances for:

children.name: text
children: Site conditions, contamination, adverse physical conditions (including ground, sub soil and sub surface conditions), artificial obstructions and existing services which arise during the course of the execution of the Sub-Contract Works, (including latent or unforeseen conditions); and

children.name: text
children: Works and facilities required as shown or described in or reasonably implied by the Order,

children.name: text
children: And shall not be entitled to any adjustment of the Period for Completion or the Sub-Contract Sum for any costs, losses or expenses by reason of such matters.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall be deemed to have visited the Site and to be fully satisfied with all local conditions, means of access, feasibility of deliveries, unloading, storage, the location of all services and drainage and all other matters which may affect the carrying out of the Sub-Contract Works and the Sub-Contractor shall not be entitled to any adjustment of the Period for Completion or the Sub-Contract Sum for any costs, losses or expenses by reason of such matters.

children.name: text
children: {b:3. CONTROL OF THE WORKS}

children.name: text
children: {b:Contractor's Obligations}

children.name: text
children: Where applicable, the Contractor shall for the purposes of the CDM Regulations be the principal contractor (unless the Sub-Contractor is otherwise notified in Writing) and shall comply with its obligations under the CDM Regulations and all other relevant health and safety legislation.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall provide free of charge such facilities and attendances as may be identified in the Sub-Contract (if any) PROVIDED THAT where such facilities or attendances are provided by the Contractor no warranty is given as to their condition or suitability for use with the Sub-Contract Works and the Sub-Contractor must

children.name: text
children: {b:Sub-Contractor's Obligations}

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall employ only competent workmen in connection with the Sub-Contract Works, and shall:

children.name: text
children: Participate in, support and abide by any stipulated the Contractor site access and identification procedures and training requirements;

children.name: text
children: Take all reasonable and appropriate precautions to ensure that any workmen or staff who will be placed in a position to influence vulnerable persons as a result of the Sub-Contract Works will have all relevant background checks and/or are adequately supervised;

children.name: text
children: Ensure that all workmen attending the Site to carry out work are in possession of an appropriate Construction Skills Certificate Scheme card.

children.name: text
children: At all times during the progress of the Sub-Contract Works the Sub-Contractor shall provide a foreman or charge hand on Site to supervise the Sub-Contract Works and receive instructions from the Contractor or the Contractor's site representative.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall provide all plant, tools and any other equipment including generators and temporary lighting (where appropriate) required to carry out and complete the Sub-Contract Works, unless the Contractor agrees in writing to provide any such plant, tools and/or any other equipment. If the Contractor agree to provide such plant, tools and/or any other equipment the Contractor shall be entitled to deduct the cost price plus 15% from any payment due to the Sub-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall at all times keep the Site (for the avoidance of doubt including, but not limited to, the canteen and toilet facilities) and access thereto in a clean and tidy condition and shall clear away all rubbish and waste arising from the Sub-Contract Works and return all surplus usable material to a suitable store or compound in accordance with the instructions of the Contractor's site representative. The Sub-Contractor shall comply with the Contractor's Site Waste Management Plan and Environmental Management Plan, copies of which are available upon request. Should the Sub-Contractor fail to clear away rubbish and waste within 24 hours of a notice from the Contractor to do so the Contractor shall be entitled to clear away all rubbish and waste and recover any costs incurred as a result from the Sub-Contractor. Without prejudice to any other rights or remedies it may have the Contractor reserves the right to charge the Sub-Contractor for any undue wastage of the Contractor's materials and goods and/or any costs incurred by the Contractor as a result of any breach by the Sub-Contractor of the provisions of this clause.

children.name: text
children: Access to the Site shall not be exclusive and the Sub-Contractor shall liaise and co-operate with the Contractor's site representative and other contractors to ensure that the Sub-Contract Works are fully co-ordinated and integrated with any works being undertaken by others on the Site.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall not sub-sub-contract any part of the Sub-Contract Works without the Contractor's prior approval in Writing. Where the Contractor consents to such sub-sub-contracting the Sub-Contractor shall remain wholly responsible for carrying out and completing the Sub-Contract Works in all respects and the Contractor shall bear no obligation or duty to any sub-sub-contractor.

children.name: text
children: Unless otherwise stated in the Order, working hours on Site shall be as agreed prior to commencement between the Contractor and the Sub-Contractor, or such other times as may be required by any relevant authority or as may be varied by the Contractor from time to time. There shall be no overtime or weekend working allowed unless agreed in writing by the Contractor. The Sub-Contractor shall indemnify the Contractor for all costs incurred in opening the Site to enable the Sub-Contractor to carry out the Sub-Contract Works over any weekend unless other contractors are present on Site.

children.name: text
children: Unless otherwise stated within the Order, the Sub-Contractor shall at all times be responsible for unloading and distributing materials in relation to the Sub-Contract Works regardless of whether these have been supplied by the Sub-Contractor or the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall be responsible for setting out and taking all relevant Site dimensions for the Sub-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall be deemed to have satisfied himself that all surfaces and backings to which materials are to be applied,inserted or otherwise affixed are suitable and in a satisfactory condition prior to carrying out the Sub-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: At least 10 days prior to the Commencement Date the Sub-Contractor shall provide a Site specific method statement incorporating relevant risk including (but not limited to) COSHH, noise and manual handling assessments. Approval of such method statements shall be at the discretion of the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Where the Sub-Contractor is responsible for managing waste (either as a Sub-Contractor or waste management contractor), it shall:

children.name: text
children: Manage (including collection, storage, segregation and treatment/disposal) the different types of waste in line with the agreed waste management method outlined at the Sub-Contractor interview meeting; and

children.name: text
children: Monitor and report at least monthly to the Contractor waste manager the quantities of the different types of waste managed, the split of each different type of waste according to waste management method – re-use, recycling, recovery (on or off site) and the quantity of waste materials sent to landfill.

children.name: text
children: Before completion of the Sub-Contract Works, the Sub-Contractor shall without further charge to the Contractor supply for the retention and use of the Contractor such drawings, calculations, diagrams and related information as the Contractor may require, showing or describing the Sub-Contract Works as built and concerning the maintenance and operation of the completed Sub-Contract Works,including any installations forming part of them.

children.name: text
children: During the Defects Liability Period the Sub-Contractor shall provide revisions to the Contractor of those documents referred to within clause 3.15 above if they no longer show or describe the as built Sub-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: Without limitation, where the Main Contract Works are notifiable under the CDM Regulations, within the time reasonably notified by the Contractor, the Sub-Contractor shall provide to the Contractor such information in respect of the Sub-Contract Works as is reasonably necessary to enable the Contractor to comply with its obligations under the Main Contract to compile the health and safety file and the construction phase plan.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may, at any time and without notice to the Sub-Contractor, supplement the Sub-Contractor’s labour and/or employ others to carry out the Sub-Contract Works. Any such action taken by taken by the Contractor shall not be a breach of this Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Variations}

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may issue to the Sub-Contractor such instructions as it sees fit to vary and modify the quantity or quality of the Sub-Contract Works (including any design, where applicable) or any other matter which may affect the carrying out of the Sub-Contract Works including, but not limited to the following:-

children.name: text
children: any addition, omission or substitution of work;

children.name: text
children: the alteration of the kind or standard of any materials or goods for use in the Sub-Contract Works; and

children.name: text
children: obligations or restrictions relating to access, working space or working hours.

children.name: text
children: Any instruction issued by the Contractor in relation to a variation under clause 3.19 shall be effective if:-

children.name: text
children: it is in Writing from the Contractors Nominated Contact

children.name: text
children: No instructions issued by the Contractor or subsequently sanctioned by it shall vitiate the Sub-Contract. The Sub-Contractor shall comply with any instruction from the Contractor immediately upon receipt.

children.name: text
children: the Contractor and the Sub-Contractor may agree in Writing an appropriate adjustment to the Sub-Contract Sum resulting from an instruction by the Contractor at any time prior to or after compliance with such instruction and any payment due to the Sub-Contractor shall be made in accordance with these terms and conditions, provided that it shall be a condition precedent to payment of any additional amount as a result of an instruction under clause 3.18 that the instruction satisfies the requirements of clause 3.19 and its sub-clauses. The Sub-Contractor shall not be entitled to loss of profit on any part of the Sub-Contract Works that are omitted.

children.name: text
children: Where the Contractor and the Sub-Contractor have not agreed or cannot agree an appropriate adjustment to the Sub-Contract Sum under clause 3.21 above the Sub-Contract Sum shall be adjusted as follows :-

children.name: text
children: where any additional, substituted or omitted work is of a similar nature or character to any parts of the Sub-Contract Works such works shall be valued by reference to the appropriate figures and/or methodology referred to or contained within the Sub-Contract (if any);

children.name: text
children: otherwise such work shall be valued at fair rates and prices as determined by the Contractor,

children.name: text
children: and any associated payment due to the Sub-Contractor shall be made in accordance with these terms and conditions.

children.name: text
children: {b:Measurement}

children.name: text
children: Where it states in the Order that the basis of the Sub-Contract is a Bill of Quantities, the quantities will be subject to re-measurement.Unless otherwise stated or agreed, such measurement shall be in accordance with the principles set out in the Main Contract and shall be valued at the rates set out in the Sub-Contract Documents. If none are set out, then analogous rates or fair rates shall be ascertained

children.name: text
children: Where the basis of the Sub-Contract is a lump sum such sum shall be adjusted by the valuation of any written instructions issued by the Contractor. Valuation of such instructions shall be at the rates set out in the Sub-Contract Documents. If none are set out then analogous rates or fair rates shall be ascertained.

children.name: text
children: All provisional sums and approximate quantities shall be deducted from all sums due to the Sub-Contractor and shall require an instruction issued in accordance with the provisions of the Main Contract and valued on a fair and reasonable basis, using rates analogous to those contained within the Sub-Contract Documents

children.name: text
children: {b:Dayworks}

children.name: text
children: No payment shall be made on a daywork basis unless the extent and nature of such work and rates and prices have been agreed by the Contractor prior to the Sub-Contractor commencing any such works.

children.name: text
children: Where the Contractor has agreed to make payments on a daywork basis the Sub-Contractor shall submit daywork sheets/vouchers containing such details as the Contractor may require no later 7 days after the work was completed.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall ensure that all daywork sheets are signed by the Contractors Nominated Contact before including such daywork sheets in any application for payment in accordance with these terms and condition

children.name: text
children: Signature by the Contractor's site representative and/or contracts manager of any daywork sheets shall be for the sole purpose of verifying the amount of time spent and shall not be deemed to amount to any authorisation or confirmation of cost or that such works have been carried out satisfactorily.

children.name: text
children: It shall be a condition precedent to the Sub-Contractor's entitlement to payment on a daywork basis that clauses 3.27 to 3.30 inclusive have been fully complied with.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding the full adherence of the Sub-Contractor to clauses 3.27 to 3.30 inclusive above, the Sub Contractor shall only ever be entitled to payment for a maximum of 4 hours of daywork carried out in relation to each item of work

children.name: text
children: {b:Inspection and Opening Up}

children.name: text
children: The Contractor (or any person authorised by the Contractor) may carry out and conduct such testing, sampling and quality control procedures as reasonably required by the Contractor. The Sub-Contractor shall provide all reasonable assistance and all required attendance in connection with such procedures. No adjustment shall be made to the Sub-Contract Sum or extension of time allowed to the Period for Completion by virtue of such procedures.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may issue instructions requiring the Sub-Contractor to open up for inspection any work covered up or to arrange for or carry out any additional test of any goods (whether or not already incorporated in the Sub-Contract Works) or of any executed work. The cost of such opening up or testing (including the cost of making good) shall be added to the Sub-Contract Sum unless part of the Contractor's standard testing sampling and quality control procedures or unless the inspections or tests show that the goods or works are not in accordance with the Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Work or Workmanship not in accordance with the Sub-Contract}

children.name: text
children: If any work, materials or goods are not in accordance with the Sub-Contract the Contractor, in addition to its other powers may:

children.name: text
children: Issue instructions in regard to the removal from the Site or rectification of all or any such work, materials or goods;

children.name: text
children: Issue any reasonable instruction required by the Contractor as a consequence of any instruction under clause 3.30.1 and no addition shall be made to the Sub-Contract Sum and no extension of time shall be given; and/or

children.name: text
children: Issue such instructions under clauses 3.28 and 3.29, to open up for inspection or to arrange or carry out tests, as are reasonable in all the circumstances to establish to the reasonable satisfaction of the Contractor the likelihood, or extent as appropriate to the circumstances, or any further similar non-compliance. To the extent that the instructions are reasonable, whatever the results of the opening up, no addition shall be made to the Sub-Contract Sum and no extension of time shall be given.

children.name: text
children: Where there is any failure to comply with the Sub-Contractor's general obligations in regard to carrying out of work in a proper and workmanlike manner and/or in accordance with the Sub-Contract, the Contractor may, in addition to its other powers, issue such instructions as are in consequence reasonably necessary. To the extent that such instructions are reasonably necessary, no addition shall be made to the Sub-Contract Sum and no extension of time shall be given and/or any loss and/or expense reimbursed.

children.name: text
children: {b:4. PAYMENT}

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall pay the Sub-Contractor the Sub-Contract Sum for carrying out the Sub-Contract Works in accordance with either clause 4.2 or 4.3 below (whichever is applicable).

children.name: text
children: Where the Period for Completion is less than 45 working days the Sub-Contractor shall not be entitled to receive any stage or interim payments and any such stage or interim payments shall be entirely at the Contractor's discretion and dealt with in line with clause 4.3.

children.name: text
children: Where the Period for Completion is 45 days or more :-

children.name: text
children: Up to the date of completion of the Sub-Contract Works (subject to the sole discretion of the Contractor thereafter unless otherwise stated in these terms), the Sub-Contractor shall be entitled to interim payments. The due dates for such interim payments shall be as set out in the Sub-Contract Particulars (each being a Due Date).

children.name: text
children: The amount of each interim payment shall be the aggregate of the value of all work properly performed and all other sums properly incurred from the Commencement Date up to the applicable Due Date calculated in accordance with these terms and conditions LESS the aggregate sum of the amounts paid or due to be paid in all previous interim payments and any other sums which the Contractor may be entitled to deduct or claim under these terms and conditions or otherwise.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall submit a fully detailed application for payment no less than 3 calendar days before each Due Date identifying the gross value of the Sub-Contract Works completed at the date of submission and all sums properly projected to be due up to the relevant Due Date LESS the aggregate sum of the amounts paid or due to be paid in all previous interim payments and any other sums which the Contractor may be entitled to deduct or claim under these terms and conditions or otherwise (the “Gross Application for Payment”). In all cases the Sub-Contractor is required to issue the Gross Application for Payment by email to pwsubconapplications@guildmore.co.uk . Such Gross Application shall be deemed received if a delivery receipt is transmitted acknowledging service at the time of submitting the application, including the date and time the Gross Application for Payment is sent.

children.name: text
children: Provided that the Sub-Contractor has issued its application in accordance with clause 4.3.3, within 5 calendar days of each Due Date the Contractor shall give a payment notice to the Sub-Contractor specifying the amount of the interim payment to be made and the basis on which such amount is calculated (a “Payment Notice”). If the Sub-Contractor’s Gross Application for Payment does not comply with clause 4.3.3, no payment in respect of that Gross Application for Payment shall become due until it is validly submitted.

children.name: text
children: Subject to any alternative payment terms as may be set out on the Order, the final date for payment shall be {DaysFinalDatePayment} days after the Due Date

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor intends to pay less than the amount stated in a Payment Notice (or deemed payment notice) then the Contractor shall give a pay less notice to the Sub-Contractor not later than 1 day before the final date for payment for that payment specifying the amount of the interim payment to be made and the basis on which such amount is calculated.

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor issues a payment notice later than the date required under clause 4.3.4 then provided that notice complies with the requirements of clause 4.3.6 it shall be deemed to be a pay less notice.

children.name: text
children: All interim payments shall be on account, shall be subject to adjustment and review following completion of the Sub-Contract Works and shall not signify any approval by the Contractor of materials, goods and/or workmanship.

children.name: text
children: {b:Final Account}

children.name: text
children: Within 7 days from the date of completion of the Sub-Contract Works the Sub-Contractor shall submit an account representing the total value of the Sub-Contract Works carried out by the Sub-Contractor and calculated in accordance with the Sub-Contract for ascertainment of the value of the Sub-Contract Works by the Contractor. the Contractor shall notify the Sub-Contractor of its ascertainment of the value of the Sub-Contract Works within 3 months of receipt of the Sub-Contractor’s account representing the value of the Sub-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor's account shall contain such details as the Contractor may reasonably require in order to properly ascertain the value of the Sub-Contract Works and calculate the final payment.

children.name: text
children: If the Sub-Contractor fails to submit an account within 7 days of the date of completion of the Sub-Contract Works the Contractor may within 4 months of the date of completion of the Sub-Contract Works value the Sub-Contract Works from the information then in its possession and notify such valuation to the Sub-Contractor and if the Sub-Contractor does not dissent from the Contractor’s valuation within 7 days of its submission to the Sub-Contractor then the Contractor’s valuation shall have effect in any proceedings under or arising out of or in connection with the Sub-Contract as conclusive evidence that any necessary effect has been given to all the terms of the Sub-Contract which require an amount to be added to or subtracted from the Sub-Contract Sum and that all and any extensions of the Period for Completion and any associated payments as are due have been given.

children.name: text
children: Any interim payments paid or due to be paid to the Sub-Contractor by the Contractor under clause 4.3, or otherwise, shall be deducted from the Contractor’s ascertained value of the Sub-Contract Works under clause 4.4 or from the Contractor’s valuation of the Sub- Contract Works under clause 4.6 as applicable and any balance shall be the final payment due to the Sub-Contractor from the Contractor or the final payment due to the Contractor from the Sub-Contractor as appropriate.

children.name: text
children: The due date for payment of the final account shall be the date being 28 calendar days after the issue of the final account by the Contractor to the Sub-Contractor and the final date for payment of the final payment shall be 45 days after the due date.

children.name: text
children: {br}
{br}
{br}
{br}

{br}
{br}
{br}

children.name: text
children: {b:Interest}

children.name: text
children: In the event that the Contractor fails to make payment in accordance with these terms and conditions the Sub-Contractor shall in addition to the outstanding sum be entitled to simple interest thereon at the rate of 1% per annum above the base rate of the Bank of England current at the date of payment calculated from the date the sum became overdue to the date payment is actually received. The Parties confirm and agree that the foregoing provisions of this clause 4.9 constitute a “substantial remedy” for the purposes of the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998.

children.name: text
children: {b:Retention}

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may deduct from any interim payment due to the Sub-Contractor a sum equivalent to the Retention Percentage.

children.name: text
children: Subject to clauses 2.8 and 2.9, on or after the First Retention Release Date the Sub-Contractor may make a written request for the release of half of the Retention Percentage. The due date for payment of such amount shall be the date being 42 days after receipt by the Contractor of the written request and payment thereafter will be dealt with in accordance with clause 4.3.4 to 4.3.8 (mutatis mutandis). the Contractor may, at its discretion, release these monies earlier than the First Retention Release Date.

children.name: text
children: Subject to the agreement of the Contractor that any defects in the Sub-Contract Works have been completed to their satisfaction and in accordance with clause 2.13, the Sub-Contractor may make a written request for release of the remainder of the retention on or after the Second Retention Release Date. The due date for payment of such amount shall be the date being 42 days after receipt by the Contractor of the written request and payment thereafter will be dealt with in accordance with clauses 4.3.4 to 4.3.8. the Contractor may,at its discretion, release these monies earlier than the Second Retention Release Date.

children.name: text
children: {b:Set-Off}

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall be entitled to deduct from or set-off against any payments otherwise due to the Sub-Contractor under the Sub-Contract or any other agreement between the Contractor and the Sub-Contractor the amount of any costs, losses expenses or damages as the Contractor shall determine as being the amount actually incurred or a fair and reasonable estimate of the amount likely to be incurred and to which the Contractor may be entitled by reason of any breach by the Sub-Contractor of any of these terms and conditions.

children.name: text
children: the Contractor's right of deduction or set-off set out at clause 4.13 shall be in addition to all common law rights of set-off or deduction and any other rights, remedies, actions, claims or demands which the Contractor may have against the Sub-Contractor and shall not affect the Contractor's right to recover any further sums due to it under the Sub-Contract or generally.

children.name: text
children: {b:Construction Industry Scheme}

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provisions under these terms and conditions, the Contractor shall not be under any obligation to make any payments to the Sub-Contractor unless the Sub-Contractor has provided the Contractor with a valid authorisation in compliance with the Income Tax (Sub-Contractors in the Construction Industry) (Amendment) Regulations 1998 (or any amendments thereto) prior to commencing the Sub-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:Value Added Tax}

children.name: text
children: the Contractor shall pay to the Sub-Contractor any value added tax properly chargeable on the supply to the Contractor of any goods and services under the Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor will need to provide evidence of their current VAT registration status prior to commencement of the Sub-Contract Works. Where the Sub-Contractor fails to provide such evidence the Contractor may withhold any amounts attributable to VAT on any outstanding payments.

children.name: text
children: {b:Invoice}

children.name: text
children: It is a condition precedent to any payment pursuant to the Sub-Contract that the Sub-Contractor sends to the Contractor a VAT invoice in the amount which is properly due and appropriate evidence. The Sub-Contractor acknowledges and accepts that no payment under clause 4 will become due or payable until such time as this clause is complied with.

children.name: text
children: {br}
{br}

children.name: text
children: {b:5. STATUTORY OBLIGATIONS}

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall at its own expense comply with and give all notices or obtain all consents required by any statute, statutory regulations, orders or the like required in connection with the Sub-Contract Works and shall provide all relevant details to the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contract Sum shall include the cost of obtaining and/or complying with all appropriate regulations and consents and the Sub-Contractor shall indemnify the Contractor against all costs, losses and expenses it may incur as a result of any breach by the Sub-Contractor of such regulations and consents.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall be responsible for the prompt and proper payment of all levies due to the Construction Industry Training Board and the Contractor may take a sum equivalent to 1.5% of any payment due to the Contractor to the extent such payment relates to labour only.

children.name: text
children: {b:6. INJURY DAMAGE AND INSURANCE}

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall be liable for and shall indemnify and save harmless the Contractor against and from any loss, expense, claim or proceedings whatsoever in respect of;

children.name: text
children: Any breach, non-observance or non-performance by the Sub-Contractor, his servants or agents of the provisions of the Sub-Contract or any of them; and,

children.name: text
children: Any act or omission of the Sub-Contractor, his servants, or agents which involves the Contractor in any liability to the client under the Main Contract; and,

children.name: text
children: All claims which may be made whether under statute or common law or otherwise howsoever arising out of or in connection with the Sub-Contract Works by any person or corporation whomsoever including the Contractor in respect of injuries to or the death of any person or in respect of damage to property including (without limitation) the Main Contract Works and the Sub-Contract Works not caused by the negligence of the Contractor; and,

children.name: text
children: Any loss or damage resulting from any claim under any statute in force for the time being or at common law or otherwise by an employee, servants and/or agents of the Sub-Contractor in respect of personal injury arising out of or in the course of his employment.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall also be liable for and shall indemnify and save harmless the Contractor against and from liability for loss or damage to the Sub-Contract Works and/or materials goods or plant. For the avoidance of doubt materials include (but are not limited to) all unfixed materials and good deliver to and placed on or adjacent to the Sub-Contract Works and/or Main Contract Works which are intended for incorporation therein.

children.name: text
children: Plant, tools, equipment or other property belonging to or provided by or on behalf of or for the Sub-Contractor, his servants or agentsand any materials which are not property on Site for incorporation into the Sub-Contract works shall be at the sole risk of the Sub-Contractor and any loss or damage to the same shall be the liability of the Sub-Contractor. The Sub-Contractor shall indemnify and save harmless the Contractor against and from liability loss or damage to those plant, tools, equipment or other property.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall adequately insure against risks of loss or damage to the Sub-Contract Works, temporary works not intended for incorporation into the Sub-Contract Works, materials, goods or plant for the full re-instatement value of the Sub-Contract Works including the physical loss or damage to the works executed and site materials, the removal of debris and shoring and propping of the works which results from physical loss or damage and professional fees and shall produce on demand policies for such insurance, together with receipts for premium for inspection by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Unless indicated otherwise in the Order or otherwise agreed to by the Contractor in Writing, the Sub-Contractor shall maintain the following policies of insurance with a minimum Standard and Poor’s Insurer Financial Rating of at least A- (A minus) for the duration of its liability under the Sub-Contract:

children.name: text
children: Public Liability - £10m for each and every occurrence or series of occurrences arising from one event, and,

children.name: text
children: Employers Liability - £10m for each and every occurrence or series of occurrences arising from one event including an indemnity to principals clause, and,

children.name: text
children: All risks – for the full re-instatement value as described in 6.4 above, and

children.name: text
children: If the Sub-Contractor has any design responsibility under the SubContract, Professional Indemnity to cover any design responsibilities -£10m each and every claim

children.name: text
children: When required to do so, the Sub-Contractor shall provide such evidence as the Contractor may reasonably require that the insurances referred to in this clause 6 are being maintained. If the SubContractor is unable to provide the evidence that the Contractor reasonably requires that such insurances are being maintained the Contractor may itself take out any such insurances and set off against any payment otherwise due to the Sub-Contractor or deduct from any payment otherwise due to the Sub-Contractor or otherwise recover from the Sub-Contractor the premiums for such insurance.

children.name: text
children: It is a condition precedent to any payment to the Sub-Contractor whatsoever under this SubContract that the Sub-Contractor has provided evidence of its current and valid insurances to the Contractor in accordance with clause 6.5 above.

children.name: text
children: {b:7. DETERMINATION}

children.name: text
children: If the Sub-Contractor shall make default in any of the following respects :-

children.name: text
children: Wholly or substantially suspends the carrying out of the Sub-Contract Works without reasonable cause; or

children.name: text
children: Fails to proceed regularly and diligently with all or any part of the Sub-Contract Works; or

children.name: text
children: Sub-contracts the whole or any part of the Sub-Contract Works without the Contractor's prior approval in Writing; or

children.name: text
children: Fails to comply with an instruction requiring the removal of work, materials or goods which are not in accordance with the Sub-Contract; or

children.name: text
children: Fails to comply with any programme or any amendments or revisions to such programme or any instructions or requests from the Contractor; or

children.name: text
children: Fails to proceed with the rectification of any defects arising during the execution of the Sub-Contract Works or the Defects Liability Period with reasonable diligence; or

children.name: text
children: Fails to provide and maintain sufficient or adequate labour on Site to comply with any programme or to remedy any delay in respect of all or any part of the programme; or

children.name: text
children: Causes or fails to prevent any loss or damage to all or any part of the Sub-Contract Works or the Main Contract Works as a result of any act, omission or default on the part of the Sub-Contractor; or

children.name: text
children: Fails to comply with any duties or obligations in respect of health and safety legislation, regulation and/or codes of practice; or

children.name: text
children: Commits any other breach of any of its obligations or duties contained within the Sub-Contract; the Contractor may (without prejudice to any other rights or remedies), issue a written notice to the Sub-Contractor specifying the default or defaults (the 'specified default or defaults').

children.name: text
children: If  the  Sub-Contractor  continues  a  specified  default  for  14  days  from  receipt  of  the  notice  under clause 7.1 (or, in the case of a default which is considered by the Contractor to be of a fundamental or repudiatory nature, such shorter period as the notice may specify) the Contractor may by a further notice to the Sub-Contractor at any time terminate the Sub-Contractor's employment under the Sub-Contract

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor does not give the further notice referred to in clause 7.2 (whether as a result of the  ending  of  any  specified  default  or  otherwise)  but  the  Sub-Contractor  repeats  a  specified  default (whether previously repeated or not), then upon or within a reasonable time after such repetition, the Contractor may by notice to the Sub-Contractor terminate the Sub-Contractor's employment under the Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: Forthwith  upon  determining  the  Sub-Contractor's  employment  under  the  Sub-Contract  and thereupon the Contractor may take possession of all goods and materials, Sub-Contractor's equipment and other things whatsoever brought on to the Site by the Sub-Contractor and may use them for the purpose of carrying out, completing and maintaining the Sub-Contract Works and may, if he thinks fit, sell all or any of them and apply the proceeds in or towards the satisfaction of monies otherwise due to the Contractor from the Sub-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor's employment under the Main Contract is determined for any reason the Sub-Contractor's  employment  under  the  Sub-Contract  shall  thereupon  also  determine  with  immediate effect.

children.name: text
children: {b:Insolvency}

children.name: text
children: 7.6. The Contractor may terminate the Sub-Contract with immediate effect by giving notice in Writing to the Sub-Contractor if the Sub-Contractor becomes subject to any of the following events:

children.name: text
children: the Sub-Contractor suspends, or threatens to suspend, payment of its debts, or is unable to pay its debts as they fall due or admits inability to pay its debts, or (being a company) is deemed unable to pay its debts within the meaning of section 123 of the Insolvency Act 1986, or (being an individual) is deemed either unable to pay its debts or as having no reasonable prospect of so doing, in either case, within the meaning of section 268 of the Insolvency Act 1986, or (being a partnership) has any partner to whom any of the foregoing apply;

children.name: text
children: the Sub-Contractor commences negotiations with all or any class of its creditors with a view to rescheduling any of its debts, or makes a proposal for or enters into any compromise or arrangement with its creditors;

children.name: text
children: (being a company) a petition is filed, a notice is given, a resolution is passed, or an order is made, for or in connection with the winding up of the Sub-Contractor, other than for the sole purpose of a scheme for a solvent amalgamation of the Sub-Contractor with one or more other companies or the solvent reconstruction of the Sub-Contractor;

children.name: text
children: (being an individual) the Sub-Contractor is the subject of a bankruptcy petition or order;

children.name: text
children: A creditor or encumbrancer of the Sub-Contractor attaches or takes possession of, or a distress, execution, sequestration or other such process is levied or enforced on or sued against, the whole or any part of its assets and such attachment or process is not discharged within 14 days;

children.name: text
children: (being a company) an application is made to court, or an order is made, for the appointment of an administrator or if a notice of intention to appoint an administrator is given or if an administrator is appointed over the Sub-Contractor;

children.name: text
children: (being a company) a floating charge holder over the Sub-Contractor's assets has become entitled to appoint or has appointed an administrative receiver;

children.name: text
children: a person becomes entitled to appoint a receiver over the Sub-Contractor's assets or a receiver is appointed over the Sub-Contractor's assets;

children.name: text
children: any event occurs, or proceeding is taken, with respect to the Sub-Contractor in any jurisdiction to which it is subject that has an effect equivalent or similar to any of the events mentioned in clause 9.5.1 to clause 9.5.8 inclusive;

children.name: text
children: the Sub-Contractor suspends, or threatens to suspend, or ceases or threatens to cease to carry on, all or substantially the whole of its business; or

children.name: text
children: the Sub-Contractor's financial position deteriorates to such an extent that in the Contractor's opinion the Sub-Contractor's capability to adequately fulfil its obligations under the Sub-Contract has been placed in jeopardy.

children.name: text
children: {b:Effect of Determination}

children.name: text
children: Upon determination of the Sub-Contractor's employment under the Sub-Contract pursuant to clause 7.2, 7.3, 7.5 or 7.6 the Sub-Contractor shall (save as otherwise provided for in clause 7.4) remove from the Site of the Sub-Contract Works all its temporary works, plant, tools, goods and materials not intended for incorporation into the Sub-Contract Works provided that property in any such items shall not have passed to the Contractor under these terms and conditions.

children.name: text
children: Upon determination of the Sub-Contractor's employment under the Sub-Contract pursuant to clauses 7.2, 7.3, 7.5 (other than as a result of the Contractor's client under the Main Contract becoming insolvent as described in clause 7.10) or 7.6 and notwithstanding anything contained in these terms and conditions:

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall not be entitled to receive any further payments until the Contractor has completed the remainder of the Sub-Contract Works and has agreed the total cost of carrying out any such works with an alternative sub-contractor;

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall not be entitled to claim any direct/indirect loss and/or expense or loss of profit or overheads;

children.name: text
children: the Contractor shall be entitled to set-off and/or recover from the Sub-Contractor all costs, losses, damages and expenses incurred or which have or may in the opinion of the Contractor be incurred by the Contractor by reason of the determination of the Sub-Contractor's employment under the Sub-Contract including (without limitation) the costs incurred in completing the remainder of the Sub-Contract Works; and

children.name: text
children: within 6 months of completing any remaining Sub-Contract Works and agreeing the total cost of such works with an alternative contractor the Contractor may, or upon receipt of a written request from the Sub-Contractor will, provide an account to the Sub-Contractor identifying any balance owing to either the Contractor or the Sub-Contractor.  Such balance shall become due 45 days after submission of the Contractor's account to the Sub-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The rights and remedies set out in clause 7 shall be in addition to any other rights, remedies, actions, claims or demands which the Contractor may have against the Sub-Contractor and shall not affect the Contractor's right to recover any further sums due to it under the Sub-Contract or generally.

children.name: text
children: If the client under the Main Contract becomes “insolvent” for the purposes of Section 113 (2) of the Housing Grants, Construction and Regeneration Act 1996 (as amended) then no further sums shall become due to the Sub-Contractor after the date of such insolvency,and the Contractor shall not be required to make any further payment to the Sub-Contractor whatsoever.

children.name: text
children: {b:8. SETTLEMENT OF DISPUTES}

children.name: text
children: If any dispute or difference shall arise between the Parties at any time in connection with the Sub-Contract then either party may refer such dispute or difference to Adjudication and the Scheme for Construction Contracts (England and Wales) Regulations 1998 Part 1, as varied from time to time shall apply.

children.name: text
children: The Adjudicator nominating body shall be the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors.

children.name: text
children: The decision of the Adjudicator shall be binding on the Parties until the dispute or difference is finally determined by legal proceedings or by an agreement in writing between the Parties made after the decision of the Adjudicator.

children.name: text
children: The Parties shall without prejudice to their other rights under the Sub-Contract, comply with the decision of the Adjudicator and shall ensure that the decision of the Adjudicator is given effect.

children.name: text
children: If either party does not comply with the decision of the Adjudicator or give effect to such decision the other party shall be entitled to take court proceedings to secure such compliance pending any final determination of the dispute or difference.

children.name: text
children: {b:9. COLLATERAL WARRANTIES}

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall within 7 days of receipt of the Contractor's request:-

children.name: text
children: enter into collateral warranties in the form(s) appended to the Sub-Contract (or such other form(s) as the Contractor may reasonably require) in favour of any employer, developer, purchaser, tenant and funder in connection with the Sub-Contract Works; and

children.name: text
children: procure that any approved sub-contractor or sub-consultant engaged by the Sub-Contractor enters into collateral warranties in the form(s) appended to the Sub-Contract (or such other form(s) as the Contractor may reasonably require) in favour of the Contractor and any employer, developer, purchaser, tenant and funder in connection with the elements of the Works and/or Sub-Contract Works for whom they are responsible.

children.name: text
children: If the Sub-Contractor does not provide collateral warranties in accordance with clause 9.1 within 7 days of receipt of the Contractor's request, no further sums shall become due to the Sub-Contractor until such collateral warranty (or warranties) has or have been provided and the Contractor will be entitled to withhold £20,000 from any payment due to the Sub-Contractor in relation to each collateral warranty which has not been provided to the Contractor until the Sub-Contractor complies with such warranty obligations.

children.name: text
children: {b:10. COPYRIGHT LICENCE}

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor hereby grants to the Contractor an irrevocable royalty free non-exclusive licence to use and reproduce all drawings, details, plans, specifications, schedules, reports, calculations and other work and all Intellectual Property Rights contained in the same including but without limitation the execution, construction, promotion, refurbishment, completion, maintenance, letting, management, sale, advertisement, extension, alteration, reinstatement and repair thereof. Such licence shall carry the right to grant sub-licences and shall be transferable to third parties.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall indemnify the Contractor against all actions, claims, demands, costs, charges and expenses arising from or incurred by reason of any infringement or alleged infringement of any Intellectual Property Rights.

children.name: text
children: Insofar as beneficial ownership of copyright and any other Intellectual Property Rights in the documents set out within clause 10.1 above is vested in any person other than the Sub-Contractor the Sub-Contractor shall ensure that a similar copyright licence is granted to the Contractor. The Sub-Contractor shall procure that any beneficial owner shall, if so requested, at any time, execute such documents and perform such acts as may be required to fully and effectively assure to the Contractor the rights referred to in this clause 10.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor waives and agrees not to assert any moral right which it may have as the author of the documents referred to in clause 10.1 above. Where the Sub-Contractor is not the author, the Sub-Contractor shall use all reasonable endeavours to obtain for the Contractor a corresponding waiver from the author.

children.name: text
children: All royalties or other sums payable in respect of the supply and use in carrying out the Sub-Contract Works of any patented articles, processes or inventions or in respect of the supply and use for the Sub-Contract Works of drawings or models of buildings the subject of copyright or other Intellectual Property Rights shall be deemed to have been included within the Sub-Contract Sum. The Sub-Contractor shall indemnify the Contractor from and against all claims and proceedings which may be brought or made against the Contractor, and all damages, costs and expense to which he may be put, by reason of the Sub-Contractor's infringing or being held to have infringed any patent rights in relation to any such Intellectual Property Rights.

children.name: text
children: {b:11. HEALTH AND SAFETY}

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall comply with its obligations under the CDM Regulations and all relevant Health and Safety regulations and codes of practice and the Contractor's health and safety policy (which is available upon request) and no less than 14 days before commencing the Sub-Contract Works provide the Contractor with such risk assessments and method statements as the Contractor may, in their sole discretion, require relating to the carrying out of the Sub-Contract Works as the Contractor may require and provide appropriate evidence of compliance with the CDM Regulations 2015 and all relevant Health and Safety regulations and codes of practice.

children.name: text
children: As applicable the Sub-Contractor shall comply with the construction phase health and safety plan which is located at the Site managers office.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor must provide appropriate personal protective equipment for all its operatives and must ensure that its operatives use this equipment at all times.

children.name: text
children: If any part of the Sub-Contract Works or any materials or plant related to it are likely to be hazardous the Sub-Contractor shall notify the main contractor.

children.name: text
children: Upon request by the Contractor the Sub-Contractor shall confirm that all plant, equipment and personal protective equipment used in connection with the Sub-Contract Works is in good working order and condition and shall provide current test certificate if applicable.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall ensure that all its operatives report to the Site manager prior to commencing the sub-contract works and sign the visitors book located at the Site.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall ensure that prior to their operatives commencing the Sub-Contract Works on Site they are given an appropriate induction to discuss the project safety plan and any global risks associated with the Sub-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:12. DOCUMENTATION}

children.name: text
children: Within 7 days of completion of the Sub-Contract Works or a written request from the Contractor the Sub-Contractor shall provide to the Contractor the following documents:

children.name: text
children: Such information as is within the Sub-Contractor's possession and is required for the operation and maintenance manuals;

children.name: text
children: any guarantees available from suppliers of goods and equipment; and

children.name: text
children: as built or final construction issue drawings.

children.name: text
children: Until such time as the Sub-Contractor has provided the documents set out within clause 12.1 above to the Contractor and these have been approved by the Contractor and (if applicable) any other third party who needs to approve such documents, the Contractor may withhold all payments that would otherwise be due to the Sub-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: {b:13. NOTICES}

children.name: text
children: Any notice under these terms and conditions shall in the case of the Sub-Contractor be given in writing and shall be sent by pre-paid registered first class post to the Contractor's address stated in the Order and shall be deemed to have been received 48 hours after the date of posting or in the case of the Contractor transmitted by e-mail to the Sub-Contractor's Nominated Contact as specified in the Sub-Contract Order (or such other person as may be agreed between the parties) and shall be deemed received at the time of sending, provided that an electronic or paper copy of the sent email including the sent date and time is obtained.

children.name: text
children: {b:14. THIRD PARTY RIGHTS}

children.name: text
children: Nothing in the Sub-Contract shall confer any rights on any person who is not named as a party to the Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: {b:15. LIMITATION PERIOD}

children.name: text
children: It is acknowledged that whatever the manner in which the Sub-Contract may have been executed the period of limitation applicable to any claim or claims arising out of or in connection with the Sub-Contract shall be twelve years from the date of completion of the Main Contract Works pursuant to the provisions of the Main Contract and accordingly the Sub-Contractor shall not be entitled to rely upon a defence pursuant to section 5 or section 8 of the Limitation Act 1980.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provision of the Sub-Contract, the Sub-Contractor agrees that it shall not be entitled to contend in defence of proceedings under the Sub-Contract or otherwise that clause 15.1 is void or unenforceable by virtue of the Unfair Contract Terms Act 1977.

children.name: text
children: {b:16. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION}

children.name: text
children: Subject to any specific agreement to the contrary contained in the Order, any contract governed by these terms and conditions shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England, and the Parties hereby submit to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the English courts.

children.name: text
children: {b:17. ASSIGNMENT}

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall not assign, transfer, mortgage, charge, subcontract, declare a trust over or deal in any other manner with any or all of its rights and obligations under the Sub-Contract without the prior written consent of the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: the Contractor may, assign, transfer or charge any or all of its rights and obligations under the Sub-Contract without the consent of the Sub-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: {b:18. CONFLICT OF INTEREST}

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor must make the Contractor immediately aware of any conflict of interest between this Sub-Contract Order and any other works, goods or services undertaken or supplied by the sub-contractor outside of this Sub-Contract Order and take all reasonably steps as directed by the Contractor to resolve the conflict

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor specifically agrees not to approach, canvass, solicit, or have any dealings whatsoever with the Main Contract Client or a subsidiary thereof for works, goods, or services for the duration of this Sub-Contract Order and for a period of 12 months thereafter without the express written consent of the Contractor

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor specifically agrees not to induce any employee, operative, agent or Sub-subcontractor engaged by the Contractor or any other Sub-Contractor employed under the Main Contract for the period of this Sub-Contract Order.

children.name: text
children: {b:19. EXECUTION}

children.name: text
children: The Parties intend the Sub-Contract to take effect as a deed notwithstanding the fact that the Sub-Contractor and/or the Contractor may only execute the Order under hand.
